unit: One selected release subset and acquisition configuration. A release may appear on multiple rows.

effector.articulated_hand: 关节手（灵巧性未独立判定）

acquisition.human_demonstration: 人工示范（控制方式未细分）

terminal.wearable_capture: 穿戴式动捕或数据手套
terminal.no_live_operator: 本次生成或回放无需实时操作者

height_coding.basis: Working catalog convention for physical reference platforms. A sourced publisher label may be reported separately. Heights outside these intervals remain unassigned. Size does not describe which joints were active.
height_coding.scope: Manufacturer/team reference dimensions, not simulation-mesh measurements.

counting: Count configurations within each category and distinct release IDs separately. Categories on different axes overlap. Release families group related releases for navigation and are not a measure of content uniqueness.
missing: undocumented means unresolved within cited sources; no_live_operator describes the immediate sampled or replayed trajectory. Sensors describe observations, not control terminals.
